question.problem: The distance between the points $(5,1)$ and $(1,-2)$ is{{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
In this case, we have ${{(5,1)}_{⏟}}_{\text{(}{x}_{1}\text{,}\,{y}_{1})}$ and ${{(1,-2)}_{⏟}}_{\text{(}{x}_{2}\text{,}\,{y}_{2})}.$ 
So, the distance $d$ can be calculated using the distance formula, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}d & =\sqrt{({x}_{2}-{x}_{1})^{2}+({y}_{2}-{y}_{1})^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{(1-5)^{2}+(-2-1)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{(-4)^{2}+(-3)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{16+9} \\  & =\sqrt{25} \\  & =5\end{aligned}
$$
